rows.title: Mommy review – outrageous and brilliant, a daytime soap from hell | Mommy
rows.dek_lead: Mommy is a tremendously acted, heartfelt, formally inventive movie. It is without the studenty and supercilious air of Dolan’s previous, rather insufferable films, such as Laurence Anyways (2012) and Heartbeats (2010).
